medicine.name: COLDRIF syrup
whatItIsFor: Reducing fever and mild body aches
Relieving runny nose, sneezing, and blocked nose
medicine.howItWorks: It lowers fever, clears nasal congestion, and blocks histamine to stop allergy symptoms.
seriousWarnings: Swelling of the face, lips, or throat causing breathing trouble
Rapid, irregular heartbeat or severe chest flutter
Severe dizziness or sudden extreme drowsiness
whoShouldBeCareful: People with high blood pressure or heart problems
People with liver or kidney disease
Very young children without clear pediatric guidance
interactions: Other medicines containing paracetamol, to avoid liver damage
Sedatives, sleeping pills, or alcohol, which increase drowsiness
Certain medicines for depression or high blood pressure
medicine.storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

disclaimer: General information, not medical advice. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before you start, stop or change a medicine.
